What's New in Version 0.1.2

  • Updated AI Enhancement models to latest versions (Feb 2026)
  • Replaced Scribe v1 with Scribe v2 — #1 ranked STT model (2.3% WER)
  • Updated Gemini transcription models to 3.1 Pro and 3 Flash
  • Removed deprecated AI Enhancement providers to simplify setup
  • Removed low-accuracy local models; existing users auto-migrated to Large v3 Turbo
  • Updated default recommended model to Large v3 Turbo (Quantized)
